depends_on.description: Resolved dependency relation between two releases.

registry_reports_signing_key.description: An ecosystem registry's metadata associates this artifact with this signing key. OBSERVATION ONLY: no cryptographic verification performed against artifact bytes. Policies requiring strong evidence MUST require `cryptographically_verified_signature_by`.

cryptographically_verified_signature_by.description: A signature over the artifact's bytes was fetched AND validated by this binary, in this run, against a known public key whose trust chain anchors to a pinned root (Fulcio public-good root for Sigstore). VERIFICATION class: occurrences naming this predicate MUST have attestor_role = verifier (epistemic-model.v1.md §3, invariant 16, layer-3.md §9). Federation imports may NEVER carry this predicate; at the boundary they are rewritten as peer_reports_* observation predicates.

cryptographic_verification_failed.description: This binary executed cryptographic verification of an attestation for the artifact and the verification did NOT succeed. The structured reason code (bundle_parse_failed, signature_invalid, certificate_chain_invalid, transparency_log_proof_invalid, subject_digest_mismatch, oidc_subject_coherence_failed, input_invalid, unknown) is recorded in the assertion's evidence sidecar (a sigstore.verification_failure raw record). REFUTATION class: positive evidence about our own verifier's behaviour, not a claim about the artifact (epistemic-model.v1.md §7.3). Occurrences naming this predicate MUST have attestor_role = verifier.

published_by.description: Identity recorded by the registry as publisher of a release.

published_at.description: Release timestamp as recorded by the registry.

affected_by.description: Artifact is affected by a vulnerability advisory.

attests_to.description: Attestation envelope refers to a subject.

revises.description: Supersession edge: this identity replaces another. Meta-predicate; carries no truth about the world, only about the log's organisation.
